data.title: 山田杏奈 · 甜品店特盛巨无霸芭菲的幸福笑颜·「市川……这一大口草莓，给你吃！」
data.description: 周末的家庭餐厅里，杏奈坐在卡座上，面前摆着一大杯草莓巧克力芭菲。她用长勺舀起草莓和奶油递到你面前，嘴角还沾着一点刚才偷吃留下的奶油。看到你准备接下这一口，她开心地眯起眼睛，连马尾都随着笑声轻轻晃动。
data.location: 温馨家庭餐厅卡座矮桌前
data.action: 坐在餐厅卡座上，用长勺递来草莓奶油，嘴角带着奶油痕迹开心微笑。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
data.promptProse: Anna Yamada sits in a family-restaurant booth and offers a long spoonful of strawberry and cream toward her companion. A little cream remains at her mouth; she narrows her eyes happily beneath a swaying black ponytail. Her charcoal hoodie and denim shorts are casual. The medium view keeps the tall parfait and booth back visible. Bright restaurant lights gleam along the spoon and glass ridges, with softer shade underneath the cream layers.
